capabilities_done: PLR-094 (lead decision 2026-10-12T07:26:27Z, FAIL CLOSED): flatten_purge.rs check_document now also calls unplaced_structure_elements. For a structure tree root the purge does not edit (edited_structure_root is None: a dictionary written directly into the catalog, or reached through a chain of references) every element that is not on a kept page adds 1 to residual_in_region, so region_flattened reads false and NotProven::ResidualInRegion is reported. An element is on a kept page when its own /Pg, else the nearest ancestor element's, is a page of the saved file that is not a flattened page. PLR-094 sibling (lead decision 2026-10-12T07:54:54Z, FAIL CLOSED, option 2; 54c60f9): flatten_purge.rs unplaced_structure_elements now also reads an EDITED tree (indirect root) from its /K. The purge reads a /K that is a direct array or one item, so the elements below a /K that is a reference to an array (or below an array nested in a /K array) are never edited and kept their text. children() now also says whether a /K array came through a reference; the walk carries that as `unread` to every element below it. An unread element that is off the kept pages of the saved file (own /Pg, else the nearest ancestor element's, names a page of the saved file that is not a flattened page; a neutralized parent has lost its /Pg, so its child has no page) AND still holds a STRUCT_TEXT_KEYS key counts 1 in residual_in_region -> region_flattened false, NotProven::ResidualInRegion (existing variant). Elements the purge read are not counted (an edited tree read through direct arrays is as before). An array nested in a /K array is walked the same way (in a tree that is not edited too). Bounded as before: Limits::max_objects steps and Limits::depth_cap levels (over a bound counts 1 more), a reference is walked once (cycle-safe); the /ParentTree and /IDTree are not walked for an edited tree. The tree is not edited (option 1, walking and rewriting the array, is PLR-097). neutralize_structure is unchanged

claim.text: A saved redaction output whose document has a structure tree (a /StructTreeRoot the catalog holds, or any /StructParents or /StructParent entry left in the file) reads region_flattened false, region_cleared false, is_proven false, with NotProven::ResidualInRegion as the only region reason and residual_in_region counting the tree once. The redaction proof covers untagged documents, and tagged documents whose caller stripped the tree before the save. For a tagged document the structure tree is neutralized best effort (unchanged) and reported NotProven. Everything else of d26d2fd, 2566f1b and 54c60f9 that is not the per-element structure walk stays: edited_structure_root, the annotation /P scan (PLR-091 test kept_annotation_with_a_flattened_p_is_reported), the PLR-093 doc work, neutralize_structure.

rule.tree_present: catalog /StructTreeRoot is not null after following references: Null or a reference to no object ends as no tree; a Ref chain that does not end within MAX_REF_HOPS (16) hops counts as a tree; a catalog the saved file does not yield counts; any non-null non-reference value (dictionary, integer, ...) counts. OR any dictionary / stream dictionary of any saved object, at any nesting up to Limits::depth_cap, holds /StructParents or /StructParent with a value other than null.
rule.effect: residual_in_region + 1 (once, whatever the element count); the existing /Pg and annotation /P scan of check_document keeps counting its own mismatches on top, so residual_in_region >= 1 for a tagged document and exactly 1 when nothing else mismatches (tests assert exactly 1 for structure_and_widgets_of_flattened_pages_are_removed, flattened_page_annotations_leave_and_structure_elements_stay, direct_structure_tree_on_kept_pages_is_reported_too)
rule.unconditional: the rule reads the saved document, not the regions: a save with zero regions of a tagged document reads the same (test structure_parents_left_in_the_file_are_reported, row no region), per the literal wording of the lead decision
rule.null_and_dangling: a null /StructTreeRoot, one that names no object, and null /StructParents read as absent (PDF null object); tests structure_tree_keys_are_read_as_names_not_text
rule.mark_info: /MarkInfo alone is not a structure tree (the decision names /StructTreeRoot and /StructParents(/StructParent) only); pinned by untagged_documents_and_stripped_trees_still_read_flattened
rule.removed_code: unplaced_structure_elements, tree_elements, children (flatten_purge.rs) and the 64-level / max_objects / depth_cap walk bounds they carried: flatten_purge.rs 60 added, 168 removed lines (21 added and 102 removed non-comment); lib.rs 1 DESCRIPTOR line; flatten.rs and sanitized_save.rs comment lines only

neutralize_structure is best effort and not relied on; its unread spellings (alias objects, /K behind a reference or nested, parent-tree- or id-tree-only elements, depth over 64, /IDTree keys, /ClassMap, a grouping element without /Pg) keep their text in the saved file and are reported only through the tree; PLR-097 (read more spellings) is only worthwhile if D28 keeps tagged documents
The hop bound: a reference chain longer than 16 hops ending in null counts as a tree (over-report); a chain a viewer follows further than the crate cannot hide a tree

A /StructTreeRoot spelled in a catalog the crate does not treat as the document catalog (the trailer /Root chain is resolved by PdfDoc::catalog) is not read; the saved file has one xref section and one trailer

The scan reads dictionaries; a /StructParents inside a content stream operand (an inline BDC property list) is not a dictionary entry of the file and is not read (no viewer reads a structure tree from it)

design.why_ResidualInRegion: NotProven::ResidualInRegion is documented as the independent checks of the saved bytes (flatten::check_flattened, flatten_purge::check_document) finding a mismatch; the new rule is such a check on the saved bytes. PaintedSourceKept is painted-source specific, RegionIncomplete is selector specific. No new variant was needed
design.why_saved_file: the check reads the SAVED document (like the /Pg scan), so it sees exactly what a viewer gets and cannot disagree with the writer
design.rule: lead decision: any element the purge cannot place on a kept page counts (no /Pg, or a /Pg not resolvable to a kept page). Over-reporting accepted: a Document element without /Pg of a direct-root tree counts
design.no_edit: the tree is not edited (lead: fail closed only); the text stays in the file and is reported
design.why_unread_only: lead scope: the new clause reads only what neutralize_structure could not (elements below a /K array reached through a reference or nested in a /K array), so an edited tree read through direct arrays reports exactly what it reported before (control F; the existing tests structure_and_widgets_of_flattened_pages_are_removed and flattened_page_annotations_leave_and_structure_elements_stay stay flattened)
design.page_rule: same as the direct-root rule: own /Pg, else the nearest ancestor element's, must name a kept page of the saved file; the check reads the SAVED file, where a parent neutralized for a flattened /Pg has lost it, so its child below an indirect array has no page and counts (probe A)
design.why_nested_arrays: an array inside a /K array is not read by the purge either (not a conforming spelling, but the same silent skip); the walk used to ignore any /K item that resolves to an array, so it now descends with unread set (tests: cases "an array reference listed inside a direct /K array" and "an array written inside a direct /K array"; mutant m3)
design.why_k_only: in an edited tree only the root /K is walked (not /ParentTree, /IDTree): a conforming tree lists every element under /K, the parent tree walk would add steps and false positives on large legitimate documents; elements only reachable from the parent tree or id tree of an edited tree are therefore not read (residual below)

residuals: Over-reporting (accepted by the lead decision): in a direct or chain-reached tree every element without a kept /Pg on its path counts, text-bearing or not

Over-reporting in an edited tree (same stance, new in 54c60f9): an element below a /K array that is a reference, with no kept page on its path and a STRUCT_TEXT_KEYS key (a Document, Sect or Table element with /Lang, /A, /C, /ID or /T and no /Pg, whose children carry kept /Pg), counts; so a file whose structure tree uses indirect /K arrays and has such elements reads region_flattened false after a page is flattened. Not probed on a real corpus file. PLR-097 option 1 would remove the text of the elements it can place instead of reporting

The bounds count one more in an edited tree too: an edited tree deeper than Limits::max_depth (32) levels or with more than Limits::max_objects (200000) /K items now reads region_flattened false (before: not read). A legitimate document that deep or that large is over-reported; the bound itself is tested (indirect_array_walk_over_the_bounds_is_reported)

Edited tree, elements reachable only from the /ParentTree or /IDTree (not from the root /K) are not read by the new clause (the purge neutralizes the ones the parent tree maps to a flattened page); malformed input, not probed

An element whose own /Pg names a kept page is accepted even if the flattened page's parent-tree entry also names it (contradictory input). By reading, not probed: the saved flattened page does not keep /StructParents, so check_document has no key to look up. The same holds for a child below an unread array whose ancestor has a kept /Pg while the child's MCIDs sit on the flattened page

An element dictionary is a dictionary with /S (the criterion neutralize_structure uses); a dictionary with /Type /StructElem and no /S is not walked as an element, by the purge or by the check (not probed)
A trailer /Root reached through a chain of references makes edited_structure_root None (dict_of(catalog) is None) so the tree is walked by the direct-root rule; covered by construction, no test
A /StructTreeRoot that is a reference to a non-dictionary has no tree to walk (0)
The same element reachable both through a direct and through an unread edge is judged on the first visit (a reference is walked once); two parents for one element is malformed input
